label: Screencap Grid — Aspect Safe
description: Per source video, renders a coordinated landscape + portrait grid pair (same cell count, cells steered to the wanted shape — landscape/square/portrait presets or an exact ratio, default landscape 16:9). Multi-input renders 2 outputs per file. Renders static PNG contact sheets or animated MP4 grids via the Output knob.

sourceIds.label: Source(s)
sourceIds.description: Source video(s) for the grid — pick a folder, one or more files, or drag-and-drop. 2 outputs per file (landscape + portrait).

outputFormat.label: Output
outputFormat.description: Deliverable format. "png" renders static contact sheets; "mp4" renders animated grids where each tile plays from its timestamp.

cellShape.label: Cell Shape
cellShape.description: What shape should the cells be? landscape = 16:9 (the natural shape for video frames), square, portrait = 9:16. Both orientations' grids are chosen so their cells realize this shape at the same cell count.

gridChoice.label: Grid Choice
gridChoice.description: Index into the ranked list of coordinated landscape/portrait grid pairs. 0 = best-ranked (both orientations' cells closest to the wanted cell shape). Out-of-range clamps to the last available pair.

search.cellAspect.label: Cell Aspect (exact)
search.cellAspect.description: Exact target cell aspect ratio (width/height) — overrides Cell Shape when set. E.g. 1.5 for 3:2 cells, 0.8 for 4:5.

search.minCells.label: Min Cells
search.minCells.description: Lower bound for the cell-count sweep.

search.maxCells.label: Max Cells
search.maxCells.description: Upper bound for the cell-count sweep.

search.label: Grid Search
search.description: Pair-search tuning: exact cell aspect + the cell-count window the ranked list sweeps.

infoPane.show.label: Show
infoPane.show.description: Show the info pane above the grid.

infoPane.align.label: Align
infoPane.align.description: Alignment of the pane text (filename + metadata).

infoPane.label: Info Pane
infoPane.description: Info pane with filename + ffprobe metadata above the grid.

timestamps.show.label: Show
timestamps.show.description: Overlay a timestamp in each tile.

timestamps.corner.label: Corner
timestamps.corner.description: Which corner the chip sits in.

timestamps.bgColor.label: Background
timestamps.bgColor.description: Chip background behind the glyphs ("none" = transparent).

tiles.gapPx.label: Gap (px)
tiles.gapPx.description: Gap between tiles, in pixels (exact at every canvas).

tiles.fit.label: Fit
tiles.fit.description: cover crops to fill; contain letterboxes the whole frame.

debugGeometry.label: Debug geometry
debugGeometry.description: Dev-only geometry contract: assert every tile's computed rect survived to the pixels at each orientation canvas; on violation that step renders a GEOMETRY_CONTRACT error mosaic. Deterministic default false; production never sets it.
